text:
nina: Alert from AR  Nimbus Tech disputed Feb invoice. They upgraded to Dedicated Premium on 2026-02-20 but our invoice shows full-month charge at new tier. They say commit credits should offset.
ethan: paste invoice snippet pls
nina: ```
INV-2026-7081
2026-02-01 - 2026-02-28 Dedicated Base: $6,000
2026-02-20 Upgrade to Premium: +$9,000
Commit credits applied: $0
```
sara: contract note: commit credits of $4,000 available, effective 2/01. Credits should apply pro rata after upgrade date. We under-applied.
michael: for revrec, recognize revenue only for service delivered. Overbilled amount should be reclassified to deferred revenue; if CN expected, record AP accrual. Quick calc: upgrade extra portion for 9 days (20-28 incl) = 9000 * 9/28 = $2,892.86. Apply $2,892.86 of credits -> net CN $0? Wait check: credits available 4k cover it. That means we owe a credit back to customer of $0 and should reallocate credits to upgraded portion. Need AR to reapply credits and update invoice.
ethan: so action: AR reapply $2,892.86 of commit credits to INV-2026-7081, adjust remaining credits ledger. Post JE for Feb close to reclassify incorrectly recognized revenue: DR Sales Rev $2,892.86 / CR Deferred Rev $2,892.86. No CN needed if credits realloc.
nina: billing-bot, please create ticket to reapply credits and track audit evidence.
billing-bot: Created BILL-7944 to reapply credits; updated customer ledger.
sara: manager review complete. We'll annotate month-end close deck and include pointer to BILL-7944.
